intro: Install Statecraft and choose what this device may share or receive.
install_body: Open Statecraft from your home screen in its own window. Your account and world stay the same.
installed: You are using the installed app.
android_install: On Android or desktop Chrome and Edge, open the browser menu and choose Install app. If it is already installed, choose Open in app.
ios_install: On iPhone or iPad, use Share → Add to Home Screen. Open that app to enable notifications (iOS 16.4 or later).
online: An internet connection is needed for live records, messages and civic actions.
location_body: Share your location when finding your home on the map or checking in. You still choose and confirm your home. There is no continuous or background location tracking. You can also select your home manually.
location_stop: Stop using location in this app
location_ready: Location works. Open residency to find and confirm your home. This check did not send or save your coordinates.
location_stopped: Location requests are turned off in this app on this device. Manual map selection still works.
location_denied: Location is blocked. Change this site's location permission in your browser or device settings, then try again. You can still choose your home on the map.
location_unavailable: Could not get a location fix. Check your device's location setting or use the map manually.
notifications_body: Receive private-room invitations, invitation acceptances, private-message alerts and reminders for upcoming civic deadlines. Private message text is not included in push previews. Notifications can arrive while the app is closed, subject to your device settings.
push_unsupported: Push notifications are unavailable here. On iPhone or iPad, install the app on your Home Screen and open it there first.
notification_denied: Notifications are blocked or were not allowed. To enable them, change this site's notification permission in your browser or device settings.
on_this_device: Notify me on this device about
invitations: Room invitations and accepted invite links
clock_residency: Confirm your home to choose a place for deadline reminders.
clock_scope: Reminders cover the next scheduled election, meeting, emergency-power or civic-stipend deadline in this place. Checks run each minute. They do not include private case deadlines or change when a clock fires.
enabled: Notifications are enabled on this device.
disabled: Notifications for that device are disabled.
test_queued: Test queued. It normally arrives within a minute; delivery also depends on your browser and device settings.
browser_controls: These app controls cannot override browser or operating-system permissions. Use the site's controls beside the address, or the installed app's system settings, to revoke a browser permission. Signing out disables notifications registered in that session.
save_failed: Could not save. Check your connection and sign-in, then try again.
worker_wait: App background support is still starting. Reload this page and try again.
